events.title: The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch Joins Steam Next Fest with a Brand-New Demo!
events.summary: Hello everyone!We'd like to share our development progress with you: the game is now 60% complete, and we expect it to be fully finished within a few months!To show you the improvements we've been making, we've released a brand-new demo for Steam Next Fest. events.title: 🎉 The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch is coming to 2025 WePlay Game Expo!
events.summary: Hello, adventurer!The Rules Kaidan: Night Watch will be exhibiting at 2025 WePlay Game Expo! Let's meet up there!⌚️ Time: November 22–23, 2025, 9:30 AM–5:30 PM (UCT+8)🗺️ Location: Hall H3, Shanghai World Expo Exhibition and Convention Center, Shanghai, China⛱️ Booth: B07🎁 There will also be cute merchandise giveaways at the event!
